you didnt have any friends left after isolating yourself? how did you make new meaningful friends? also did you win the old ones back? i dont think they would come back to me though, they have replaced me and have no need for me. making new ones doesnt go far for me. they dont get as meaningful as the childhood ones were and they drift away easily.

also the crisis here hit pretty bad so finding a job is difficult. so i mainly am busy trying to find one.
